hooks.name: Update Docs on File Create
hooks.description: When a file is created or deleted, prompts to update documentation (ARCHITECTURE.md, module READMEs, diagrams) and evaluate if new steering/hooks are needed

action.prompt: A new file was created in the project. Evaluate: 1) Does the parent folder README need updating? 2) Does ARCHITECTURE.md need a diagram update? 3) Is a new steering file or hook needed for this new pattern? If yes to any, make the updates.
